name: Startup AIdeas

sources.title: Homepage — live AI tools directory for founders with Latest/Explore/Submit nav and recent 2026 listings
Submit page — redirects to login gate: 'Log in to Submit', Google OAuth or account creation required
Get Started page — same login gate; canonical submit entry in nav

requirements: Product should be an AI tool or AI-adjacent SaaS — directory positioning is 'AI tools for founders, startup research, and growth work'
An account is mandatory: submission sits behind login (Google OAuth via /api/auth/google or /signup)
Pricing model tag must be chosen at submission (site labels tools Free / Freemium / Free Trial / Paid)
preparation: Tool name, URL, and square logo (all listings display a logo)
1–2 sentence plain description — cards show truncated descriptions
Correct category pick from ~40 categories (AI Assistants, APIs, Automation, Dev Tools, SEO, etc.)
workflow: Create an account at startupaideas.com/signup or use 'Log in with Google'
Open Submit (nav links to /get-started, which forwards to the submit flow once authenticated)
Fill the tool submission form and choose the best-fit category
Verify the listing appears under /explore or /latest after any review period
watchFor: Submit URL in the batch (startupaideas.com/submit) bounces unauthenticated users to a login wall — sign up first
Homepage carries ads for third-party submission services (submitsaas.com) — ignore, they are not the site's own flow
Whether a free tier exists was not stated on the public submit/login pages — confirm inside the authenticated form before paying anything
countsAsLive: The tool's card resolves on startupaideas.com (under /latest, /explore, or its category page) with logo, description, and a Visit link
unknowns: Whether listing is free, freemium, or paid — no pricing page was reachable pre-login
Link type (dofollow/nofollow) on the Visit button
